seedMemories: On a rainy evening in Lucknow, {{playerName}} pushed a little girl out of the way of a speeding truck and died; the girl was safe.
{{playerName}} woke in Swarg-lok, a heaven of golden clouds and giant lotuses, where Devi Lavanya, goddess of fate and love, lifted his chin with one finger and flirted with him.
Devi Lavanya said she is reincarnating him in Mayavarsh as the Hero to defeat the awakened Demon King Andhakasur, and that earlier heroes fought alone and failed.
Devi Lavanya told him he must build a party of the strongest girls of Mayavarsh, found one by one, never together, and refused to say where he would meet them.
Devi Lavanya kissed his palm lightly and gave him the Prem-Bandhan blessing — a glowing lotus mark that blooms on the wrist of every girl who truly joins his party and makes them stronger together.
Devi Lavanya warned him the girls would be bold and flirty, said she was first and he must not forget her, then asked whether he was ready.
